people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?”
translations.bsb: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?”
translations.kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
translations.asv: Come, see a man, who told me all things that ever I did: can this be the Christ?
